title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Usage Intensity and the Damage Deductible on Metered Equipment
content:
How hard a metered Ridgeline Tool Rental unit was worked moves the damage deductible.

**Rule.** How hard the unit was worked moves the deductible: on metered equipment whose engine hours used average fewer than 4 hours per day of the deductible's day count, the deductible is multiplied by 0.90; on metered equipment averaging 8 or more such hours, by 1.10; on metered equipment averaging 4 to under 8 hours, and on unmetered equipment, it is unchanged.

**Day count.** The day count of the deductible is the daily periods billed, plus 7 for each weekly period, 28 for each four-week period, half a day for each four-hour period and 2 for a weekend special.

**Average.** The engine hours used are the hour meter reading at return less the hour meter reading at checkout; the average is those hours divided by the day count. Metered equipment is a class with engine hours included per billed day above zero on the metering table.

The multiplier acts on the damage deductible before the deductible is held to the repair cost assessed at the return inspection, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Usage table

| Equipment | Average engine hours per day of the day count | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| metered | below 4 | 0.90 |
| metered | 4 up to below 8 | 1 (unchanged) |
| metered | 8 or more | 1.10 |
| unmetered | not applicable | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical readings (metered unit, 3 daily periods billed, day count 3)

| Engine hours used | Average | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | 3 | 0.90 |
| 12 | 4 | 1 |
| 23.7 | 7.9 | 1 |
| 24 | 8 | 1.10 |

With one weekly period and 1 daily period the day count is 8, so 30 engine hours average 3.75 and take 0.90.
